Nvidia's total revenue rose about 114.2% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025. This is from memory of Nvidia's 10-K filings, not from a search.

- Fiscal 2024 (ended January 2024): $60,922 million
- Fiscal 2025 (ended January 2025): $130,497 million

The change is (130,497 − 60,922) / 60,922 ≈ 1.142, or about 114.2%.
